sections.heading: C — Registration, insurance, other info
sections.markdown:
## C — Registration, insurance, other info

FACT_ID: sec15-F01 | anchor: A01
Licenses arrive by mail only, never over DMV counters; movers must tell DMV within 30 days since the post office will not forward licenses and returns them instead [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0035]

FACT_ID: sec15-F02 | anchor: A01
New Virginians owe a state license within 60 days and title, registration, and plates within 30 days, worn front and rear with month-year decals in their plate slots except on permanent plates [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0035]

FACT_ID: sec15-F03 | anchor: A01
Keep the registration card aboard every drive, and register locally too where your city or county demands it [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0035]

FACT_ID: sec15-F04 | anchor: A01
Pass the yearly safety inspection and wear its sticker, plus emissions testing where your locality orders it [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0035]

FACT_ID: sec15-F05 | anchor: A01
Monthly or pre-trip, start the penny test by pinching Lincoln's body between thumb and finger [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0035]

FACT_ID: sec15-F06 | anchor: A02
Sink Lincoln's head into the barest groove: tread hiding any of it means safe rubber, while less guts wet grip; gauge pressures before boarding against the manual or door-jamb PSI [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0036]

FACT_ID: sec15-F07 | anchor: A02
Registration wants liability from a Virginia-authorized carrier or the $500 uninsured fee; minimums run $25,000 per person, $50,000 per crash, $20,000 property before Jan. 1, 2022, and $30,000, $60,000, $20,000 after, with household driving-age records able to price premiums [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0036]

FACT_ID: sec15-F08 | anchor: A02
The fee buys no coverage, only a one-year right to run; insure across the whole registration span even parked or dead, and surrender plates plus registration before dropping coverage [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0036]

FACT_ID: sec15-F09 | anchor: A02
Caught bare without the fee, driving dies until a $600 noncompliance payment or plan plus an insurer certificate riding three years past reinstatement [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0036]

FACT_ID: sec15-F10 | anchor: A02
DMV doubles as voter registrar via the license form for citizens residing in Virginia and eighteen by the next general election, with felons and the incompetent needing circuit-court restoration first [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0036]

FACT_ID: sec15-F11 | anchor: A02
Check yes on license, permit, or ID forms to donate organs, eyes, and tissue; eighteen-plus decisions bind, under-eighteen wishes bow to parents and guardians, and every donor should broadcast the choice to kin [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0036]
